scenarios.title: Partner with searches the library for the named card when the permanent enters
decisions: A casts Pir, Imaginative Rascal, tapping the three Forests; it resolves and enters the battlefield.
The partner with trigger targets A; both players pass.
On resolution A chooses to search the library for Toothy, Imaginary Friend, reveals it, puts it into hand, and the library is shuffled.

variants.label: named_card_in_library
variants.expected: Toothy, Imaginary Friend moves from A's library to A's hand and A's library is shuffled.

variants.label: named_card_absent
variants.delta: A's library holds three Forests and no Toothy, Imaginary Friend.
variants.expected: The trigger resolves and A finds nothing. A's hand stays empty, and the library is shuffled.

scenarios.forge_notes: The Commander-designation half of partner with is out of scope; only the enters trigger is illustrated.
